recent_en: The Company held its 16th AGM on 24 November 2026, with all resolutions passed. It also released its quarterly consolidated results for the period ended 30 September 2026. Recently, Director Dato' Sri Chiang Fong Yee has made multiple notifications of changes in his shareholdings and given notice of intention to deal during the closed period.
notable_en: The 16th AGM was held on 24 November 2026, and all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
Director Dato' Sri Chiang Fong Yee gave notice of intention to deal in the Company's securities during the closed period.
